rules.mergePolicy: Human/editor review after gates and deployment preview
rules.sourceOfTruth: Portfolio concepts do not automatically confer team authorship

tasks.title: Deployment truth and rollback
tasks.brief: Verify Cloudflare/GitHub deployment from accessible evidence; do not infer success from merge or CNAME.
acceptance: Route/HTTP table for root/apps/store/My Space/Atlas; public vs preview SHA; screenshot/404 evidence; rollback path

tasks.title: Portfolio QA knowledge transfer
tasks.brief: Review portfolio PR #130 #132 #134 #121 #94 and convert only proven process into team gates.
acceptance: Matrix: source PR → mechanism → team adaptation → unsafe-to-copy assumptions → owner decision

tasks.title: Space information architecture and service semantics
tasks.brief: Freeze VIRTURA Space vs Studio vs SpacePort vs Archive; Space as worlds first, tools and courses auxiliary. Research Wii/iCloud, not clone interface.
acceptance: Approved sitemap, 3 user journeys, canonical zh/en naming, route redirect/compatibility map, content weights

tasks.title: Unified visual direction and safe homepage redesign
tasks.brief: Protect root homepage hero, 7 works cards, people, inquiry and existing routes. Propose image-driven layout system before any root rewrite. VI v05 draft replaces the legacy global green palette with monochrome studio-derived shell and distinctive project imagery. Prototype must be reviewed before production work.
acceptance: Approved visual target, reused tokens, before-after captures at 375/768/1440 + zh/en, image aspect integrity, no scroll overflow, rollback

tasks.title: Media rights and asset mapping
tasks.brief: Audit cover assets and edition correctness for TIMER/Drop Flow/SpacePort/SceneForge. Never invent sources or crop originals destructively.
acceptance: At least 8 priority images with dimensions, hash, mapped work/edition/rights, decode and screenshot evidence

tasks.title: Team Credit and editorial truth
tasks.brief: Validate specific editions, team vs individual roles, portraits and institution claims; do not infer exclusive authorship or commercial rights.
acceptance: TIMER/Drop Flow edition-level credit matrices and unresolved flags; no invented job titles or ownership

tasks.title: Independent app experience QA
tasks.brief: Actually open 13 curated app links; test start/input/output/exit on desktop/mobile, annotate XR as unverified unless physically tested.
acceptance: Each app runtime URL, step-by-step journey, broken refs, QA screenshots, evidence-based category downgrade/upgrade

tasks.title: SpacePort/IP experiential map
tasks.brief: Turn existing worlds and archives into a real navigable port/world itinerary; no invented playable IP; fictional banking distinct from financial services. Treat each verified world as a recurring media channel with distinct maps, art direction, releases and creator credits; avoid creating empty accounts.
acceptance: Playable / archive / lore matrix, one 5-minute proof-of-experience, independently deployable routes and rights

tasks.title: App registry and identity contract
tasks.brief: Reconcile 33 raw assets vs 13 curated items, add schema and gate; identity sync OIDC/Workers/D1 remains proposal until real need and threat model.
acceptance: Unique ID authority, source links, app lifecycle schema, privacy model; no token or premature cross-device auth implementation

tasks.title: Commercial service design and sustainable release loop
tasks.brief: Choose 3 productizable services rooted in actual work and consented media, separate studio client services from fictional world IP, avoid empty store. Evaluate world-specific original ambience/music/video publications and creator economics only after a finished release pilot and valid rights.
acceptance: 3 products: target client, authentic demo, deliverable, rights, scope, support cost and verified CTA; monthly update rules
